description.value: BReD is a 100% plant-based, certified-organic sourdough bakery in Creekside, Whistler, founded by British-born baker Ed Tatton and his wife Natasha. Every loaf is naturally leavened with a wild sourdough starter and made from certified organic flour, with a rotating daily schedule of specialty breads. Beyond bread, the in-store café serves espresso drinks and the shop stocks a curated range of local pantry goods including organic flours, artisan jams, and hummus.

address.value: 206–2067 Lake Placid Road, Whistler, BC, V8E 0B6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (edsbred.com) is fully accessible and provides the primary evidence. The website consistently shows phone (604) 388-0372 across multiple subpages, contradicting the OSM phone +1-604-967-3838 — the website value is used. The shop sells certified organic flours, jams, hummus, olives, and coffee beans alongside bread, qualifying as basic groceries; the about page explicitly mentions espresso-based drinks served in-store, qualifying as hot food. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cycle-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
